checks.name: selected-file-consent-is-fixed-and-secret-free
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_auth import authorization
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,parse_qs
url=authorization({'client_id':'123-synthetic.apps.googleusercontent.com','client_secret':'synthetic-secret'},8768,'drive_'+'s'*43,'v'*64)
assert isinstance(url,str), 'Consent must return a URL'
parts=urlsplit(url);q=parse_qs(parts.query)
assert parts.netloc=='accounts.google.com' and q['scope']==['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file']
assert q['trigger_onepick']==['true'] and q['redirect_uri']==['http://127.0.0.1:8768']
assert 'synthetic-secret' not in url and 'v'*64 not in url
